extraction: Ralph workflow cost arbitrage: route work to cheapest capable agent. Engine (expensive: GPU, long runtime) → only for build. Verdict (cheap: CPU, short) → for verify. Miss (cheap: CPU, short) → for apply. Don't use Engine for verification. Maps to our campaign: Engine builds engines (GPU if available, else CPU). Verdict verifies (CPU only, fast). Miss patches (CPU only, fast). Cost optimal. No paid LLM calls for any agent.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether role specialization (Engine=build, Verdict=verify, Miss=apply) minimizes cost
